items.problem: A fully clean, zero-deferral migration is flagged with a spurious '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows' by Validate-UwpMigration.ps1.
items.evidence: session-log.txt:3609 '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows — check consistency'; trial MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md contains a '| (none) | — |' row and never the string 'No items deferred'.
items.skill_search: Grepped Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 for 'DEFERRED', 'No items deferred', 'defer'.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1:439-441 writes `if ($deferredKeys.Count -eq 0) { [void]$dlines.Add('| (none) | — |') }`, but Validate-UwpMigration.ps1:266 requires the sentinel: `if ($deferText -notmatch 'No items deferred') { Write-Host "[WARN] ..." }`.
items.root_cause: The two migration-skill scripts disagree on the zero-defer sentinel: Initialize seeds a '(none)' table row; Validate's PASS branch only recognizes the literal 'No items deferred'. The scaffold therefore produces a state its own validator warns about.
items.proposed_fix: In Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1's DEFERRED.md seeding, when $deferredKeys.Count -eq 0 emit the exact sentinel line 'No items deferred.' (in addition to or instead of the '(none)' row) so Validate takes its PASS branch.
items.generalizes: Most well-formed UWP->WinUI 3 migrations (simple sensor/API samples especially) have zero deferrals, so this false WARN fires on the common happy path of essentially every scenario, adding noise and prompting agents to second-guess a clean result.
